limitations: No particle momentum load or thermal/Doppler feedback to cross sections; explicit data temperature intervals are enforced.
Quasistatic nonmultiplying multigroup transport; isotropic scattering, first-order upwind Cartesian cells.
Fixed group data and geometry during each history; no temperature-dependent nuclear data or depletion.
Local deposition and dose responses require explicitly processed, compatible material data; none supplied.
Escaping secondary energy is a ledger, not an explicitly transported secondary species.
No fission, multiplication, charged particles, implantation, transmutation, gas production or calibrated lifetime.
Discrete angular ray effects, spatial and energy-group convergence must be demonstrated for the application.
